description: Returns one role by id, whether saved or only listed, with full description, company, location and remote terms, salary, posted date, match score, saved state, board column, application id, material readiness and work-eligibility verdict. url is the Dreamwork listing page; sourceUrl is the employer's direct posting. eligible is true for an unrestricted role or a confirmed allowed country, false for a high-confidence restriction excluding confirmed countries, and null when eligibility is unknown. Only false blocks applying or Autopilot: null means eligibility is not yet known, so proceed with applying — the application itself surfaces any real restriction. whyItMatches may be empty when no match explanation is stored.

jobId.description: Listing id or private-job id from the feed or envelope.

name: get_job

sourceUrl.description: The employer's direct posting URL. url is the job's page on Dreamwork.

url.description: The job's page on Dreamwork. sourceUrl, where present, is the employer's direct posting.

whyItMatches.description: The matcher's own reasons for this person, when it recorded any.
